name: stor-elvdal-hotell-landing-page
description: Premium static landing page prototype for Stor-Elvdal Hotell in Koppang.

scripts.check:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for path in ['index.html', 'styles.css', 'script.js', 'server.js']:
    data = Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    if not data.strip():
        raise SystemExit(f'{path} is empty')
    print(f'{path}: {len(data)} bytes')
PY
